data.text: Physical USB test PASSED on Noah laptop. One exclusive official Atech SDK owner forwarded62 actual samples; temporary CO2trigger829ppm/30s caused one incident/localtesttask/sound. Firmware acknowledged office_say, led_kitchen_fill and speaker_play_rtttl; user explicitly heard three-note chime. Fresh physical sample recovered incident; exact original1200/1000ppm,3samples/30s,alert+ticket rule restored and testtask resolved. Sound command read back delivered only after user confirmation. Board now unplugged per user; no serialowner/continuous bridge left. PR5 updated with explicit co2_co2/co2_temperature/co2_humidity/aht20 aliases;66Python+11bridge tests pass. Existing remote atech_bridge.py throttles CO2 to60s, which exceeds rules max_gap30s: hardware owner must forward actual CO2 at sensor cadence (~5s), not60s, and poll station command queue for continuous behavior.
